A fire unto itself is an ongoing sacrificial rite, throwing its shapes upon the transmogrifying pyre of its dazzling body, in ode to the gods of forest and wind. We see this dance as those fleeting licks and flickers of the earth born sun. Just like fire, a miasma of beautiful incompletions, from moment to moment live the conclusion of endless departure, and invite with open arms fresh, incipient blazing, born of the love of source and resource.
